name: grantlane
description: Milestone grant escrow — bonded claims settled by UMA's optimistic oracle on Base, a Chainlink CRE settlement workflow, identity by World ID.

scripts.contracts:build: wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc 'export PATH=$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH; cd contracts; forge build'
scripts.contracts:test: wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc 'export PATH=$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH; cd contracts; forge test -vv'
scripts.workflow:typecheck: wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc 'export PATH=$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH; cd cre-workflow/settlement-workflow; bun x tsc --noEmit'
scripts.workflow:build: wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc 'export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH; cd cre-workflow; cre workflow build settlement-workflow --target staging-settings'
scripts.workflow:simulate: wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc 'export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH; cd cre-workflow; cre workflow simulate ./settlement-workflow --target staging-settings --non-interactive --trigger-index 0 -e .env'
scripts.workflow:broadcast: wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc 'export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH; cd cre-workflow; cre workflow simulate ./settlement-workflow --target staging-settings --non-interactive --trigger-index 0 --broadcast -e .env'
